payload.title: Editor outline and copywriter draft commands from the standard packs
payload.description: Ryan 2026-11-03. Decisions: the editor's outline comes after research. Add the `process` layer to every pack, `papyrus stories outline --story L` (editor profile, saves an outline version with the marker) and `papyrus stories draft --story L` (copywriter profile, saves the next version, runs the check that follows a save). GPT-6 Luna. Neither publishes. Try both on the Machines on Machines facial-recognition Story (item-idea-6cfd7da9e098a17e) and report critically. Requires the procedure ticket and the pack ticket.
